name: Mir Admin Note
author: mirmehranarjmand

sections.description:
Mir Admin Note adds a private editorial note system to the WordPress admin area. Notes are never displayed to site visitors.

Features:
* Multiple private notes per post or page.
* Normal, Important, and Done statuses.
* Note author and timestamp.
* Notes column in Posts and Pages lists.
* Central Admin Notes screen with search and status filtering.
* Role-based access controls.
* @username mentions inside notes.
* Internal notification center and unread count.
* AJAX note creation from the editor.
* English source language with Persian translation support.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/ or install the ZIP from Plugins > Add New.
  2. Activate Mir Admin Note.
  3. Open a post or page and use the Admin Notes box.
  4. Configure role access under Admin Notes > Settings.
sections.faq:
Can visitors see the notes?

No. Notes are only available in the WordPress admin area to users with permission.

How do mentions work?

Type a valid WordPress username after @, for example @mehran. The mentioned user receives an internal admin notification.
